ten: Word – Chương 2: Chèn và định dạng chữ, đoạn, section – Đề 1
ten_en: Word – Chapter 2: Insert and format text, paragraphs and sections – Test 1

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C2D1_P1_Bakery.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C2D1_P1_Bakery.docx and complete the tasks below in order.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đổi kiểu chữ hoa của tiêu đề “Pastry Platters” thành Capitalize Each Word.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Change the case of the heading “Pastry Platters” to Capitalize Each Word.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề.  2) Home > Change Case (Aa) > Capitalize Each Word.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the heading.  2) Home > Change Case (Aa) > Capitalize Each Word.

cham.de_bai: Change the case of the heading “Pastry Platters” to Capitalize Each Word.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đặt giãn dòng 1.6 lines cho toàn bộ tài liệu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Set the line spacing to 1.6 lines for the entire document.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Ctrl+A để chọn toàn bộ.  2) Home > Line and Paragraph Spacing > Line Spacing Options.  3) Line spacing: Multiple; At: 1.6 > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Press Ctrl+A to select everything.  2) Home > Line and Paragraph Spacing > Line Spacing Options.  3) Line spacing: Multiple; At: 1.6 > OK.

cham.de_bai: Set the line spacing to 1.6 lines for the entire document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Áp dụng text effect Fill: Orange, Accent color 2; Outline: Orange, Accent color 2 cho tiêu đề tài liệu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Apply the Fill: Orange, Accent color 2; Outline: Orange, Accent color 2 text effect to the document title.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề tài liệu.  2) Home > Text Effects and Typography > chọn Fill: Orange, Accent color 2; Outline: Orange, Accent color 2.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the document title.  2) Home > Text Effects and Typography > select Fill: Orange, Accent color 2; Outline: Orange, Accent color 2.

cham.de_bai: Apply the Fill: Orange, Accent color 2; Outline: Orange, Accent color 2 text effect to the document title.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Delivery”, chia hai đoạn văn sau tiêu đề thành 2 cột.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Delivery” section, format the two paragraphs after the heading into 2 columns.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn văn (không chọn tiêu đề).  2) Layout > Columns > Two.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the two paragraphs (not the heading).  2) Layout > Columns > Two.

cham.de_bai: In the “Delivery” section, format the two paragraphs after the heading into 2 columns.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Ở cuối câu “Golden Crust Bakery can print a photo or message on the top of any cake.”, chèn ngắt section kiểu Continuous.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: At the end of the sentence “Golden Crust Bakery can print a photo or message on the top of any cake.”, insert a continuous section break.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ ngay sau dấu chấm cuối câu.  2) Layout > Breaks > Section Breaks: Continuous.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor right after the period at the end of the sentence.  2) Layout > Breaks > Section Breaks: Continuous.

cham.de_bai: At the end of the sentence “Golden Crust Bakery can print a photo or message on the top of any cake.”, insert a continuous section break.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C2D1_P2_Computer.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C2D1_P2_Computer.docx and complete the tasks below in order.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “How Are Computers Used Today?”, đổi giãn dòng của hai đoạn văn sau tiêu đề thành Exactly 12 pt.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “How Are Computers Used Today?” section, change the line spacing of the two paragraphs after the heading to exactly 12 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn văn dưới tiêu đề.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog (mũi tên nhỏ) > Line spacing: Exactly; At: 12 pt > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the two paragraphs below the heading.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog launcher > Line spacing: Exactly; At: 12 pt > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “How Are Computers Used Today?” section, change the line spacing of the two paragraphs after the heading to exactly 12 pt.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Computer Connections”, tô sáng (highlight) câu “TechStart Academy teaches students how to stay safe online.” màu Pink.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Computer Connections” section, highlight the sentence “TechStart Academy teaches students how to stay safe online.” in Pink.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn câu văn.  2) Home > Text Highlight Color > Pink.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the sentence.  2) Home > Text Highlight Color > Pink.

cham.de_bai: In the “Computer Connections” section, highlight the sentence “TechStart Academy teaches students how to stay safe online.” in Pink.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đổi phông chữ của tiêu đề “What Parts Are Needed for a Computer to Work?” thành Arial Black, 18 pt.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Change the font of the heading “What Parts Are Needed for a Computer to Work?” to Arial Black, 18 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề.  2) Home > Font: Arial Black; Font Size: 18.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the heading.  2) Home > Font: Arial Black; Font Size: 18.

cham.de_bai: Change the font of the heading “What Parts Are Needed for a Computer to Work?” to Arial Black, 18 pt.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Bật tự động ngắt từ (automatic hyphenation) cho tài liệu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Turn on automatic hyphenation for the document.

cham.de_bai: Turn on automatic hyphenation for the document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Dùng một tính năng của Word để thay mọi chữ “TechStart Academy” bằng “TechStart Co.”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “TechStart Academy” with “TechStart Co.”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace (Ctrl+H).  2) Find what: TechStart Academy; Replace with: TechStart Co..  3) Replace All > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Home > Replace (Ctrl+H).  2) Find what: TechStart Academy; Replace with: TechStart Co..  3) Replace All > OK.

cham.de_bai: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “TechStart Academy” with “TechStart Co.”.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C2D1_P3_Weekdays.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C2D1_P3_Weekdays.docx and complete the tasks below in order.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Chèn ký hiệu Registered (®) ngay sau lần xuất hiện đầu tiên của “Timekeepers Club” trong tài liệu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Insert the Registered symbol (®) immediately after the first instance of “Timekeepers Club” in the document.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ ngay sau "Timekeepers Club" đầu tiên (không có khoảng trắng).  2) Insert > Symbol > More Symbols > tab Special Characters > Registered > Insert > Close.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor right after the first "Timekeepers Club" (no space).  2) Insert > Symbol > More Symbols > Special Characters tab > Registered > Insert > Close.

cham.de_bai: Insert the Registered symbol (®) immediately after the first instance of “Timekeepers Club” in the document.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tìm chữ “A survey of students showed that Friday and Saturday are the most popular days.” và áp dụng style Emphasis cho nó.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Locate the text “A survey of students showed that Friday and Saturday are the most popular days.” and apply the Emphasis style to it.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Dùng Ctrl+F tìm câu trên và chọn đúng câu (kể cả dấu chấm).  2) Home > Styles > Emphasis.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Use Ctrl+F to find the sentence and select exactly the sentence (including the period).  2) Home > Styles > Emphasis.

cham.de_bai: Locate the text “A survey of students showed that Friday and Saturday are the most popular days.” and apply the Emphasis style to it.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đặt khoảng cách đoạn (Paragraph Spacing) cho toàn bộ tài liệu là Double.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Set the paragraph spacing for the entire document to Double.

cham.de_bai: Set the paragraph spacing for the entire document to Double.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Chèn ngắt trang (page break) trước tiêu đề “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Insert a page break before the heading “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ đầu tiêu đề.  2) Insert > Page Break (hoặc Ctrl+Enter).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor at the start of the heading.  2) Insert > Page Break (or Ctrl+Enter).

cham.de_bai: Insert a page break before the heading “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”.
